text:
eval-bot: nightly-evals: retrieval summary for RAG-corpus-2026 (2026-03-17 02:00 UTC). recall@5 dropped 0.82 -> 0.63, MRR 0.71 -> 0.52. Failing prompt set: support_faqs_small (17/120 fail cases). run: https://ci.internal/evals/2026-03-17/5678

anya: saw this, tagging @lina and @hao. We rolled a reranker weight change at ~01:30 UTC. Did we also push any embedder quant flags in the same window?

lina: we only changed reranker weight in ranking-service config (reranker_weight 0.7 -> 0.5). No embedder config was in that rollout.

hao: I'll pull indexer + serving logs for the 01:20-01:40 window.

mike: quick note: reranker model in canary is rerank-bert-ltr-v1.4 (replaced rerank-small-v2). I thought the weight was 0.6 in the plan, where did 0.5 come from?

anya: rollout id is rollout-20260317, I see the applied config shows 0.5. I'll escalate rollback if we confirm this correlates.

lina: initiating rollback in canary now. @infra-bot canary-toggle reranker-weight rollout-20260317 --rollback

infra-bot: executed: rollback request accepted for rollout-20260317. Status: success in canary region; propagation to other regions in progress.

eva: while rollback is in flight, I ran a quick vector norm comparison between embeds v2.1 and v2.2. Mean L2 norm changed 9.8 -> 4.2 after v2.2 because we enabled s8 quant fallback on CPU. If we forgot renormalize on the quant path, cosine-based recall would drop.

hao: can you paste the script you used?

eva: sure, quick snippet I ran locally: ```python
import numpy as np
old = np.load('embeds_v2.1.npy')
new = np.load('embeds_v2.2.npy')
print(np.mean(np.linalg.norm(old,axis=1)), np.mean(np.linalg.norm(new,axis=1)))
```

mike: also noticed reranker tokenization changed handling of short answers (trims special tokens differently). That could penalize FAQ-style short responses and explain failcases.

anya: plan proposal: 1) confirm rollback effect by triggering adhoc eval; 2) verify embedding normalization exists on all serving paths (esp quant CPU fallback); 3) diff reranker tokenization behavior; 4) if rollback fixes, reintroduce reranker with staged ramp and monitoring. Agreed?

lina: starting adhoc eval: `/eval/run --suite RAG-corpus-2026 --override start_now true`

eval-bot: adhoc eval started: run_id 2026-03-17-ad1. ETA ~12m. Dashboard: https://ci.internal/evals/run/2026-03-17-ad1

hao: running index check: `SELECT count(*) FROM index_shards WHERE version='v2.2' AND normalized=false;` -> 0. Indexer writes include normalization, but that doesn't mean the serve path didn't skip it for quant fallback.

eva: found serving bug: quantized CPU codepath in embeddings service skipped the l2-normalize step when using the s8 fallback. Filed PR: github.com/redwood/embeddings/pull/422 (adds explicit normalization after dequant).

mike: that lines up. If embed norms shrink and reranker weight was reduced, the combined effect could tank recall on short-text retrieval.

lina: adhoc results posted by eval-bot: https://ci.internal/evals/run/2026-03-17-ad1/results

eval-bot: adhoc eval complete: recall@5 = 0.81, MRR = 0.70. support_faqs_small failcases 17 -> 2. Summary: rollback + embed_norm fix recovered most regressions. Root cause: interaction of reranker weight change + quantized embedding path missing normalization.

anya: great. Actions: (a) pin embedder to v2.1 until backport of normalization to v2.2; (b) backport PR#422 and add unit test for quantized path normalization; (c) re-roll reranker weight as staged canary: 5% -> 20% -> 60% with automated hold if recall drop > 0.03 on the canary evaluation set; (d) add tokenization regression test for reranker short-answer behavior; (e) update nightly alert to fire when recall@5 drops > 0.08 so we can triage faster.

mike: I'll create the reranker tokenization test and run it against both rerank-small-v2 and rerank-bert-ltr-v1.4.

lina: I'll update the rollout config and runbook. Once PR#422 is merged and pinned, I'll schedule a controlled 5% canary.

eva: I'll open a follow-up doc with reproducer and the embed_norm patch details.

anya: thanks everyone :thumbsup: Closing loop: incident -> triage -> fix -> controlled rollout. We'll monitor nightly eval tomorrow and watch support_faqs_small closely.
summary: Investigated a nightly recall drop caused by reranker weight change combined with a missing normalization in the quantized embedding serving path; rollback + embed fix recovered recall. Follow-ups: backport normalization, staged reranker rollout, add regression tests and alerting.
